Class TimingDiagramsTransmitter

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.common.UDPTransmitter2<StateTransitionTiming, TimingDiagramDefinition>
sysmlinjava.views.timingdiagrams.TimingDiagramsTransmitter
public class TimingDiagramsTransmitter extends UDPTransmitter2<StateTransitionTiming, TimingDiagramDefinition>
The TimingDiagramTransmitter is a specialization of the UDPTransmitter2 to transmit timing diagram data to a TimingDiagramReceiver for the display of timing diagram data. This class simply implements the UDPTransmitter2's transmit(StateTime) and transmit(TimingDiagram) operations for the timing diagram data objects by transmitting objects via the UDPTransmitter2's generic transmit operations.

      Constructur with UDP port specification
      Parameters:
      udpPort - UDP port which to transmit StateTime data to
      logToConsole - whether to send all transmit() logs to console. Note: transmit() operation can log every object's toString() string to the console. The more frequently log messages are sent to console, the greater the CPU resources are needed. This can cause noticable slowing of the console display and related applications.
